title: マイルCS南部杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin decides to enter the Mile Championship Nambu Hai. And the venue for the race is…

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Welcome home, Yukino Bijiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch, ev'rybody!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oh, she must be that homegrown star I've been hearing about! It sure is amaz'n how she can run on turf and dirt!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: We'll be cheer'n for you! You got this!
choice_data_list: I guess this what they mean by home field advantage.
I guess this what they mean by home field advantage.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Yep, and now I gotta thank ev'rybody with a win.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo! It's been forever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It sure has! I hope you've been good!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: She's in the same running club I was in when I was a li'l rascal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How're things going lately? Last time I saw you, y'were all excited about beat'n your best lap time!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're look'n kinda blue there. Did someth'n happen?

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Actually… I'm think'n about quitt'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How come?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You told me b'fore that you were gonna run in the centrals, like me!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was the plan. But once I thought it over, I realized there's no way I could just leave my mom and li'l bro b'hind.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: 'Sides, it's not like I've got any real talent anyway. I know I'd never make it to the centrals.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean you gotta give up completely… Didn't y'say you love runn'n?

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aw, c'mon, Yukino! I'm too old t'have my head stuck in the clouds!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're still in elementary school!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess even elementary students know when t'face facts.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna have t'give up sooner or later. Might as well do it sooner, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna live at my own pace like my mom and li'l brother, help'n out on the farm. That's my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Urk…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the start of the race approaches…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin still seems hung up on her conversation with the young girl from before.
choice_data_list: You need to get your head in the game.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know. It's just…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm runn'n in the centrals and I couldn't even think of anyth'n t'say to her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I get where she's com'n from. That's why I couldn't bring myself to tell her to keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …I've got no business tell'n her to put her back into someth'n just 'cause she likes it.
choice_data_list: You'll just have to perform well enough that it'll make her want to put in the effort.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Get out there and put in a dazzling performance that inspires her to dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's right… I gotta show her what I learned in the central races… I gotta inspire her just like I was inspired…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Honestly… I'm not too conf'dent I can pull that off. But I gotta try!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want her t'see the Star of Morioka shine!
